name: UGC 288 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 288, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc288-hubble
story: A lone dwarf irregular galaxy, UGC 288 is one of the nearby galaxies whose red giant stars Hubble used as markers of distance, to map the local universe in three dimensions.

claims.text: UGC 288 is an isolated dIrr galaxy
The program measured distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of red giant branch stars, to build 3D maps of galaxies
